DisabledTests.*-TLS1-*: DTLS 1.0 is not supported (RFC 8996 deprecates it)
DisabledTests.*-TLS1: DTLS 1.0 is not supported (RFC 8996 deprecates it)
DisabledTests.*-RSA_WITH_*: Static RSA key exchange is not offered: RFC 9325 §4.1 requires forward secrecy, WebRTC uses ECDHE (RFC 8827 §6.5)
DisabledTests.*_CBC_*: Only AEAD suites are offered (RFC 9325 §4.2; WebRTC requires AES-GCM, RFC 8827 §6.5)
DisabledTests.AppDataBeforeHandshake-DTLS*: Records that cannot be valid are silently discarded (RFC 6347 §4.1.2.7) rather than aborting the handshake
DisabledTests.AppDataBeforeTLS13KeyChange-DTLS*: Records that cannot be valid are silently discarded (RFC 6347 §4.1.2.7, RFC 9147 §4.5.2) rather than aborting the handshake
DisabledTests.SendInvalidRecordType-DTLS: Records of an unknown type are silently discarded (RFC 6347 §4.1.2.7) rather than aborting the connection
DisabledTests.WrongMessageType-NewSessionTicket-DTLS: DTLS 1.2 session tickets are not offered, so the runner never sends the NewSessionTicket this test alters
DisabledTests.TrailingMessageData-NewSessionTicket-DTL: DTLS 1.2 session tickets are not offered, so the runner never sends the NewSessionTicket this test alters
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-ProcessInOrder-DTLS: The runner merges its KeyUpdate into a NewSessionTicket flight and panics when the server sends none; ours only sends tickets with resumption on
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-ExtraMessage-DTLS: The runner merges its KeyUpdate into a NewSessionTicket flight and panics when the server sends none; ours only sends tickets with resumption on
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-ExtraMessageBuffered-DTLS: The runner merges its KeyUpdate into a NewSessionTicket flight and panics when the server sends none; ours only sends tickets with resumption on
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-MaxReadEpoch-DTLS: The runner merges its KeyUpdate into a NewSessionTicket flight and panics when the server sends none; ours only sends tickets with resumption on
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-ToClient-DTLS: A KeyUpdate is acknowledged at once (RFC 9147 §7 allows it); the runner expects BoringSSL's ACK timer, which the test never fires, and rejects the ACK
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-Requested-DTLS: A KeyUpdate is acknowledged at once (RFC 9147 §7 allows it); the runner expects BoringSSL's ACK timer, which the test never fires, and rejects the ACK
DisabledTests.KeyUpdate-ToClient-PacketLoss-DTLS: A KeyUpdate is acknowledged at once (RFC 9147 §7 allows it); the runner expects the ACK only after BoringSSL's ACK timer
DisabledTests.UnencryptedEncryptedExtensions-DTLS: A plaintext record after handshake keys exist is silently discarded (RFC 9147 §4.5.2) rather than ending the handshake
DisabledTests.DTLS-Retransmit-BothTimers-TLS13*: Open: our retransmission and ACK timers do not follow the schedule the runner checks (expect-next-timeout)
DisabledTests.DTLS-Retransmit-PartialProgress-Client-T: Open: after partial progress of a flight the client's timer does not follow the schedule the runner checks
DisabledTests.DTLS-Retransmit-Client-NoImplictACKFinis: Open: the client answers a retransmitted server flight in a way the runner reports as an unexpected message
DisabledTests.ReorderHandshakeFragments-*-DTLS-TLS12: Open: the client resends its ClientHello (record version DTLS 1.0) after part of the server's flight arrived; BoringSSL stops resending on partial progress
DisabledTests.MixCompleteMessageWithFragments-DTLS-TLS: Open: the client resends its ClientHello (record version DTLS 1.0) after part of the server's flight arrived; BoringSSL stops resending on partial progress
DisabledTests.ReorderHandshakeFragments-*-DTLS-TLS13: Open: under heavy reordering the client sends a record in an epoch the runner does not expect
DisabledTests.MixCompleteMessageWithFragments-DTLS-TLS: Open: under heavy reordering the client sends a record in an epoch the runner does not expect
DisabledTests.DTLS13-SendExtraFinished-*: Open: an extra Finished after the key change is refused with the wrong alert, in an epoch the runner does not expect
DisabledTests.DTLS13RecordHeader-OldHeader: Open: a DTLS 1.3 record with the DTLS 1.2 header after the handshake is not handled as the runner expects
DisabledTests.DTLS13RecordHeader-CIDBit: Open: a DTLS 1.3 record with the CID bit set without negotiated CIDs is not handled as the runner expects
DisabledTests.ClientAuth-Server-TLS13-DTLS-*-PackHands: Open: with packed 2-byte fragments the server acknowledges a set of records the runner does not expect
